channel.description: Welcome to the South African Weather Service RSS Feed for Weather Warning Alerts

item.title: Severe Thunderstorms
item.description: Damages to properties and settlements (formal and informal) due to wind and hail. Flooding of low-water bridges, roads and susceptible settlements. Disruptions to power supply and communications.

item.title: Severe Thunderstorms
item.description: Localised damage to infrastructure, settlements (informal), properties, vehicles and livelihood Localised flooding of susceptible roads and bridges. Localised and short term disruption to power supply and communication.

item.title: Damaging Winds
item.description: Localised runaway fires. Localised damage to settlements both formal and informal. Localised power and communication interruptions. Localised problems for high-sided vehicles on prone routes due to cross winds on exposed high level roads/bridges. Localised disruption of small harbours and/or a port for a short period of time.
